eventDetail.scope: IEECIS 2026 aims to respond to the global trend of digitization and intelligence extending into the "edge" of the network. Grounded in Information Engineering, with Edge Computing as the core technological paradigm, and building Intelligent Systems as the ultimate goal, it deeply integrates advanced technology clusters such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), Blockchain, and Low-altitude Technologies. The conference focuses on their innovative applications in key fields like smart agriculture, intelligent manufacturing, and smart cities, aiming to explore a new paradigm for a closed-loop system from data generation and processing to intelligent decision-making.
